reason: R2 only provides a DC reference path for node net44, which is otherwise connected only to C0. If C0 is used as a compensation/AC element, net44 can be left floating without changing the core differential amplifier biasing or gain paths.

impact_estimate: Low-to-medium (gain and bias point may shift; removal is typically OK if downstream circuitry provides a load/DC path).
